title.full: What you need for a nomination

summary.text: You need your Singpass, your nominees’ details, and details for two witnesses.

details.heading: Get help in person
details.body: You can visit any ServiceSG Centres to seek assistance to make an online Nomination.

details.heading: Witnesses and nominees
details.body: Your witnesses cannot be your nominees.

steps.name: Gather nominee details
steps.text: Get each nominee’s NRIC or FIN. You may also provide their email address.

steps.name: Gather witness details
steps.text: Find two witnesses. Get each person’s full name, NRIC or FIN, email address, and Singapore-registered mobile phone number.

steps.name: Check foreigner details
steps.text: If a nominee or witness is a foreigner, get their mailing address. Your witnesses cannot be your nominees.

example_phrasings: What do I need for a nomination?
What details do I need for my nominees and witnesses?

quotes.text: For nomination, you will need the following:
Your nominees’ NRIC/FIN and (optional) email address.
Two witnesses, Full Name, NRIC/FIN, email address and Singapore-registered mobile phone number.
If your nominees or witness is a foreigner, you will need to furnish their mailing address as well.
You can visit any ServiceSG Centres to seek assistance to make an online Nomination.
Your witnesses cannot be your nominees.
